name: axisvault
description: AxisVault — zero-knowledge password manager (web, desktop, server)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run build:server
scripts.dev:server: concurrently -n shared,server -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:shared" "npm run dev -w packages/server"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n shared,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev:shared" "npm run dev -w packages/web"
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w packages/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w packages/desktop
scripts.migrate: npm run build:server && npm run migrate -w packages/server
